title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must correctly express the horizontal distance as sqrt(2*mu*R*h).

title: Friction Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the maximum static friction force must be correctly derived as f = mu*mg.

title: Velocity Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the horizontal velocity v must be correctly shown as v = sqrt(mu*R*g).

title: Time Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The time to fall distance h must be correctly calculated as t = sqrt(2*h/g).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used in calculations should be consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or miscalculating the friction force.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases, such as what happens when mu approaches zero or h approaches infinity.
